title: Hyperpolyglot side-by-side reference sheets
description: Every sheet on hyperpolyglot.org (Clark Grubb's side-by-side reference tables) with the catalog language ids of its columns, plus the per-section anchors of each sheet tagged by concept. All anchors were read from the sheets' own section header rows (<a name=...>) and concept tags were chosen from the row titles in each section; sections that are empty on the site or have no fitting concept (net and web, gui, graphics, databases, version) are omitted.

resources.title: Hyperpolyglot — index of side-by-side reference sheets
resources.notes: Each sheet is one table: rows are tasks/features grouped into fixed sections, columns are languages; explanatory notes follow the table.
